finding.title: Deduplicate tool/device_e2e/run{2,3,4,5,6,7}_full_suite.mjs into one parameterized orchestration module
finding.rule: AG-1 (route through committed scripts, no ad-hoc variants) + Fowler duplication

evidence.quote: `## Judgment calibration (avoid the false positives from run 1)`,
excluded: ['#16 RTL segmented stranded — re-rejected (deferred workflow + run-2 confirmed SegmentedButton mirrors correctly...)'],

finding.why: diff run2_full_suite.mjs against run3/4/5/6/7 shows each 256-line file differs from run2 by EXACTLY 3 lines (name, output dir, one description string) — 1536 lines of near-total copy-paste across 6 files. The concrete cost is visible: the calibration text 'avoid the false positives from run 1' (line 43) is frozen verbatim since run2, yet the SAME false positive (RTL segmented controls auto-mirroring) had to be independently rediscovered and excluded in run3 (run3_fix.mjs:104, '#10... contradicted between runs') and AGAIN in run5 (run5_fix.mjs:97, '#16... re-rejected'). Because the shared logic isn't factored into one module, a lesson learned in one run never propagates to the others — the next run(run8+) will hit the same wall.
finding.recommendation: Extract the shared constants/builders (DEV map, driveGuide/seedPrompt/auditPrompt/verifyPrompt, the phase pipeline) into one importable module parameterized by {runId, priorFixSummary, areaPartitions}; each runN_full_suite.mjs shrinks to its run-specific area/seed data plus a call into the shared runner. Fold the RTL-segmented-controls lesson (and similar recurring false-positives) into the shared calibration text once, permanently.
acceptance_criteria: A shared tool/device_e2e/_full_suite_lib.mjs (or similar) exports the orchestration/prompt-builder logic; runN_full_suite.mjs files import it instead of redefining it.
Each new runN_full_suite.mjs is materially smaller than 256 lines (only run-specific data), checkable by a simple line-count grep in CI/Makefile.
The RTL-segmented-controls calibration note is asserted exactly once in the shared module (grep -c across tool/device_e2e/*.mjs returns 1, not 6).

finding.title: Delete or fix the dead, non-compiling tool/seed_content_db.dart fragment at repo root
finding.rule: Tier-2 AREA NOTE: dead code, drift between duplicated configs
finding.why: The file this batch was asked to audit — root-level tool/seed_content_db.dart (242 lines) — has NO imports, NO `void main()`, and references types/constants (Dio, ContentDatabase, _Args, _curricula, _maxConcurrentFetches, ...) that are defined nowhere in the file. It cannot compile as a standalone Dart script. The real, complete, actively-referenced seed-build tool lives at learning_tracker/tool/seed_content_db.dart (809 lines, proper imports, invoked by learning_tracker/Makefile:236,239 and documented everywhere as `cd learning_tracker && ...`). The root copy is tracked in git, has its own commit history, and is not referenced by any Makefile target or doc's actual invocation instructions — it is pure orphaned duplicate content that will confuse anyone (human or agent) who opens 'tool/seed_content_db.dart' from repo root expecting the real build tool.
finding.recommendation: Delete the root-level tool/seed_content_db.dart (git history preserves it) since the canonical tool already lives at learning_tracker/tool/seed_content_db.dart. If some workflow genuinely needs a repo-root entry point, make it a one-line wrapper that shells into the real file, not a stale content fork.
acceptance_criteria: tool/seed_content_db.dart at repo root is removed (or reduced to a documented redirect), and `dart run tool/seed_content_db.dart` from repo root either doesn't exist as a workflow or correctly delegates to learning_tracker/tool/seed_content_db.dart.
A grep/CI check fails if two files share a basename under tool/** and learning_tracker/tool/** with diverging content, to prevent recurrence.

finding.title: Escape jq string interpolation in tool/linear-sync.sh before it corrupts YAML on titles/authors containing a quote
finding.rule: Tier-2 AREA NOTE: correctness of tooling (silent corruption)
finding.why: All 5 sites build a quoted YAML scalar by raw string-concatenating a Linear-supplied value (issue title, or comment author name) between literal backslash-quotes, with no escaping of embedded `"` characters. Any Linear issue titled e.g. `Fix "broken" login` (or a comment author display name containing a quote) produces a line like `title: "Fix "broken" login"` in sprint-status.yaml, the per-story .yaml cache files, AND the generated epics.md — a malformed value with no error raised anywhere in the pipeline (set -e doesn't catch it, since jq itself succeeds). Downstream, docs/planning/epics.md's AUTO:EPIC-LIST block (also written by this script) silently carries the corrupted text into checked-in documentation.
finding.recommendation: Replace the raw `"...\"" + .field + "\""` concatenation with jq's `(.field | tojson)` (or `@json`) at all 5 sites, which correctly escapes embedded quotes/backslashes/newlines and is still valid YAML flow-scalar syntax.
acceptance_criteria: Feed a synthetic Linear issue JSON with a `"` in .title (and .user.name for comments) through the jq filters; the emitted YAML parses cleanly via `python3 -c "import yaml,sys;yaml.safe_load(sys.stdin)"` or `yq`.
All 5 sites (lines 301, 323, 336, 381, 388) use tojson/@json instead of manual quote concatenation.

finding.title: Reconcile the first AVD entry across avd-setup.ps1, emulators-start.ps1, and adb-connect-wsl.sh
finding.rule: Tier-2 AREA NOTE: drift between duplicated configs
finding.why: avd-setup.ps1's own $MATRIX creates the port-5554 device as API 24 on a 'Nexus 5' profile named `lt_api24_nexus5`. But emulators-start.ps1's $ALL_AVDS and adb-connect-wsl.sh's EXPECTED_NAMES/EXPECTED_APIS both expect an AVD literally named `lt_api28_pixel2` (API 28, Pixel 2) at that same port — and both agree with EACH OTHER, only avd-setup.ps1 disagrees. All 4 other matrix rows (29/31/34/36.1) match perfectly across all 3 scripts. Following avd-setup.ps1's own documented next step ('Start all 5: .\tool\emulators-start.ps1') on a fresh machine launches `emulator -avd lt_api28_pixel2`, which was never created — that emulator slot fails to boot, and adb-connect-wsl.sh's health check for it reports NOT FOUND.
finding.recommendation: Pick one name/API/device-profile for the port-5554 slot and make all 3 scripts agree — most likely revert avd-setup.ps1's first matrix row back to api=28/device='Pixel 2'/name='lt_api28_pixel2' to match the other two (already-agreeing) scripts, unless the API-24 floor change was intentional, in which case propagate it to emulators-start.ps1 and adb-connect-wsl.sh instead.
acceptance_criteria: The AVD name/API/port for the first device slot is identical across avd-setup.ps1, emulators-start.ps1, and adb-connect-wsl.sh.
Running avd-setup.ps1 followed by emulators-start.ps1 boots all 5 emulators, verified by adb-connect-wsl.sh reporting 5/5 ONLINE.

finding.title: Remove the duplicated/truncated KNOWN-DEFERRED block in tool/vision_find_pass.js

evidence.quote: - city subtitle still shows raw GeoNames code "NN" (the build SCRIPT is fixed; the cities.sqlite ASSET regen is
- add-track wizard step-count denominator branches (6 → 7 → 4) by path — this is INTENDED, pinned by TS-11 tests

finding.why: The KNOWN template string (fed verbatim into every one of the 9 parallel agent prompts via briefFor at line 213) contains ~9 'KNOWN-DEFERRED' bullets stated twice back-to-back (lines 134-151 then 152-168). The FIRST copy is truncated mid-sentence at line 151 ('...the cities.sqlite ASSET regen is') and jumps straight into an unrelated bullet already stated earlier — only the second copy (line 167-168) completes the sentence ('...pending a GeoNames source download — known, do not re-flag.'). This is accidental content left over from appending an updated list without deleting the old one; it bloats every agent invocation's prompt with garbled, redundant text.
finding.recommendation: Delete the first (truncated) copy of the KNOWN-DEFERRED bullet list, keeping the second, complete copy (which also has one bullet — the Hebrew-Terms-toggle-hidden note — that the first copy lacks).
acceptance_criteria: `grep -c "add-track wizard step-count denominator branches" tool/vision_find_pass.js` returns 1, not 2.
The KNOWN string contains no truncated sentences (each bullet's parenthetical closes).
